name: Races Mixing
overview: Scripture reveals a tension between the Old Testament command in Deuteronomy 7:3, which forbids intermarriage with certain peoples to preserve covenant faithfulness, and the New Testament mandate in Matthew 28:19 to make disciples of all nations, underscoring the gospel's reach beyond ethnic boundaries. Malachi 2:10 and Acts 10:34 affirm that all humans share one Creator and that God shows no partiality, emphasizing unity in Christ rather than ethnic division. True belonging in God's kingdom, as John 3:5 teaches, is based on spiritual rebirth rather than racial identity, and Jesus' command to love one another (John 13:34) calls believers to transcend racial distinctions in their relationships.
